name: osha 300a filing preparation

product.purpose: Prepare a source-linked annual OSHA 300A review worksheet from customer-confirmed injury and hours data.
product.channel: Local Glacier workflow; no public mailing or paid checkout is enabled.
product.government_submission: The establishment executive reviews, certifies, submits through the establishment's OSHA ITA account, and posts the signed summary. Glacier never certifies or submits.

schedules.purpose: Show locally stored annual OSHA filing reminders.

your_steps.title: Confirm coverage and establishment details
your_steps.detail: Check the establishment identity and OSHA coverage rules for its size and industry. Add current employee count, customer-confirmed injury totals, hours, and headcount.

your_steps.title: Review, certify, and submit
your_steps.detail: The executive reviews the worksheet, signs/certifies it, and submits it in the establishment's OSHA ITA account. Glacier does not sign or submit.

your_steps.title: Post the signed summary
your_steps.detail: Post the customer-certified 300A summary at the establishment. Save the ITA confirmation and signed posting copy in the local job folder.

launch_gates: Owner reviews first five customer-prepared worksheets.
Executive certification and customer ITA submission remain customer-controlled.
No postcard campaign, checkout, or delegate access until separately configured and approved.
